reason: E1 shows that nanoscale ordering and grain boundaries in FeCoNiSiAl cause domain wall pinning, supporting the premise that ordered clusters can increase coercivity. However, no cited evidence addresses Ga addition, its effect on ordering in FeCoNi, or the specific processing-structure-property relationship proposed; these key premises are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Nanoscale ordered clusters can pin domain walls and increase coercivity
Ga addition to FeCoNi can induce short-range chemical ordering
Controlled homogenization and cooling can produce nanoscale ordered clusters while retaining single-phase fcc
Domain wall pinning by ordered clusters increases coercivity without significantly degrading saturation magnetization
